game: Dipsy Doodle / Doodle Bug / Love Bug

sections.Profile:
"Doodle Bug," a pinball machine manufactured by Williams in 1971, features an engaging gameplay designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche. This electro-mechanical machine includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and a kick-out hole. A notable feature is the "Doodle Bug" scoring mechanism, where a captive ball moves across a point-scoring button, adding a unique dynamic to the game.
